## Type

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Skill update (bump version)
- [ ] Installer / tooling
- [ ] Docs / metadata

## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter `name` matches the folder name
- [ ] `references/` files ship alongside `SKILL.md`
- [ ] `marketplace.json` updated (name, version, description, accurate `files` list)
- [ ] Version bumped (Semantic Versioning) for any skill change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and README catalog table updated
- [ ] Installer tested end to end (skill lands in the skills dir; MCP server registers)
